Package com.stockroom.ui.theme

Class Theme

java.lang.Object
com.stockroom.ui.theme.Theme
public final class Theme extends Object
The "Stockroom Ledger" design system: every colour, font and shared painting helper used by the user interface.

The look is a physical stockroom ledger: warm paper, black ink, a single signal-orange accent and rubber-stamp status colours. No component hard-codes a colour or font; they all read the constants and factory methods here.

Fonts are the bundled OFL fonts Space Grotesk (headings) and IBM Plex Mono (data, labels and numbers), loaded from /fonts on the classpath and registered with the GraphicsEnvironment. If a font file is missing or unreadable the matching logical font (SansSerif or Monospaced) is used instead, so the application still runs.

Call install() once at start-up, before any Swing component is created, so that text antialiasing and the Swing defaults take effect.

  • Method Details

    • install

      public static void install()
      Prepares Swing for the Stockroom Ledger look. Turns on text antialiasing, loads and registers the bundled fonts and installs ledger colours and fonts as Swing defaults.

      Call this once on start-up, before any component is created.

    • installUiDefaults

      private static void installUiDefaults()
      Writes ledger colours and fonts into the Swing defaults table, so that standard components (labels, text fields, tables, tooltips) match the custom-painted ones instead of showing the default Metal look.

    • loadFont

      private static Font loadFont(String fileName, String fallbackFamily, int fallbackStyle)
      Loads one bundled font file and registers it with the graphics environment.
      Parameters:
      fileName - name of the font file inside /fonts
      fallbackFamily - logical font family to use if loading fails
      fallbackStyle - style of the fallback font, such as Font.BOLD
      Returns:
      the loaded font at size 1, or the fallback font if the file is missing or unreadable
